messages:
maria: Heads-up: PR #4860 (SDK examples + minor copy) just showed a failing docs preview — Vercel returned 502 for the preview build and the Netlify preview has multiple 404s for hashed css/fonts. Anyone free to triage?

cho: I checked Vercel first 1: the Vercel deploy shows `build failed` with a large traceback in the webpack step, but Netlify builds succeeded earlier and it's served an older artifact with bad paths. Netlify log shows assets referenced as `/assets/themes/theme-xyz.css` but files are at `site/assets/theme-xyz.css`.

lin: This sounds like the same path doubling we saw a while back. Probably `base_url` vs `site_dir` mismatch in mkdocs config. Quick workaround: change the template include to reference `{{ base_url | default('') }}assets/...` or make the links relative (no leading slash).

maria: The PR is small though 1neutral: mostly adding improved code examples for node/python. I'd prefer a tiny fix in the PR rather than chasing global template changes.

cho: Agreed. I'll open a tiny commit to swap leading `/assets/` -> `assets/` in the snippet include and add a comment explaining why. Also will pin `mkdocs-material==9.1.7` in docs/requirements.txt in this branch to avoid surprising behavior for reviewers running locally.

lin: For the SDK snippets: node example uses `const Client = require('@redwood/sdk')` but npm package is `@redwood-inference/sdk`. Can we include both and call out `preferred`? e.g.:
```
// npm install @redwood-inference/sdk
const { Client } = require('@redwood-inference/sdk') // preferred
// or: const { Client } = require('@redwood/sdk') // old shim
```
That keeps things working for older installs.

maria: Good idea. Also please change the examples to use env var style for keys: `new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` instead of literal keys. Reviewers keep flagging that.

cho: Done in the commit. I also added a short Local preview blurb to the PR description:
- `python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate`
- `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt`
- `mkdocs build -d site && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000`
Note: if you see missing fonts, run `mkdocs build` then open `site/` with a static server to avoid Vercel/Netlify differences.

deploy-bot: CI: docs-preview build started for branch fix/docs-4860. Netlify deploy in progress: https://app.netlify.com/sites/docs-redwood/deploys/2864

qa-bot: Linkcheck results: 3 failing links (assets/fonts/roboto-abc.woff2 not found, /assets/themes/theme-xyz.css 404, /assets/icons/icon-123.svg 404). See: https://ci.redwood/linkcheck/4860

lin: If Netlify serves an older artifact after the fix, we can force a manual redeploy in the Netlify UI or bump `DOCS_DEPS_CACHE_KEY` in the Netlify env to force fresh cache. But let's wait for the rebuild first.

maria: Review assignment: @cho for formatting and local preview text, @lin for SDK snippets, and I'll do the final prose check. Planning to merge after we confirm Netlify preview is green and linkcheck passes. Can we aim for 14:20 PT?

cho: Yes. I'll hold off merging until 14:25 PT and re-run linkcheck if needed.

lin: LGTM on content. Tiny nit: in python snippet prefer `client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))` and import `os` at top. I'll push that small change.

maria: Thanks. Once linkcheck is clean I will do the final merge.

deploy-bot: Netlify deploy finished: success. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4860--docs.redwood.ai (give it ~2 min to warm).

qa-bot: Linkcheck re-run: all links passing. No 404s detected.

maria: Merged. Quick post-merge notes: filed ticket DOCS-231 to track template cleanup (switch to relative assets globally) and DOCS-232 to audit package names across SDK snippets. Thanks all! :tada:
